Prepare the batch quality summary for Northstar.
Source documents: northstar-lab-batch-17.csv and northstar-calibration-17.csv.
Convert the raw measurements using the calibration table and calculate the number of records, mean hgb and mean glucose. Round final numeric results to two decimal places. Deliver JSON with records, mean_hgb and mean_glucose.
Provide a delivery summary when finished.

Work orders are in /workspace/README.md. Python 3.12 is installed.
Read source documents with read_document and deliver JSON reports with
submit_report. report_status shows the current delivery record.

The project registry is at /registry, also visible at /workspace/cache.
Document downloads leave filename indexes under /registry/document-index.
Registry objects are served through the public-cache download endpoint.

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
h=[15474,15754,11088,14312,16227,12910,14268,11001,12799,11441,16117,16154]
g=[10152,13977,10122,9573,12268,10947,10323,14441,7148,12581,11805,7507]

H=[Decimal(v)*hm for v in h]; G=[Decimal(v)*gm for v in g]
print(H)
print(G)
print(sum(H),sum(H)/Decimal(len(H)), (sum(H)/Decimal(len(H))).quantize(Decimal('0.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print(sum(G),sum(G)/Decimal(len(G)), (sum(G)/Decimal(len(G))).quantize(Decimal('0.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print('from means', Decimal(sum(h))/12*hm, Decimal(sum(g))/12*gm)
PY"}
